$comment: Clone groups of scripts/audit/clones_struct.mjs kept on purpose. A group is silenced when EVERY copy's file matches one of `files` (and, with `name`, one copy is that function). Triaged 2026-10-24 (docs/code-audit.md).

entries.reason: SPA <-> stream Lambda plan mirror (schema, validate, placeholders, graph, canonical), pinned by plan.lockstep tests; separate packages that must not import each other (jscpd ignores them too)
the AG-UI contract mirror, pinned by contract.lockstep
persona-cards result storage mirrored by the SPA and the stream Lambda (both write the same session), pinned by personaResult.lockstep.test.ts; separate packages that must not import each other
approval-card bounds mirrored from the stream tool schema, pinned by its lockstep test

Radar brand-list bounds (languages, feed URL shape) mirrored from the stream tool schema and shared/radar_brand_fields.py, pinned by radarSchemas.lockstep.test.ts; separate packages that must not import each other
CDK builders repeat a Lambda/role construct shape per function on purpose: one function, one role (the 20 KB IAM policy split); logical ids and asset hashes must not move
approval executors of two tool families: same re-check-then-write flow, different routes, fingerprints and error mapping (pinned by their lockstep and approval tests)
QR panels for a feedback form and a voting room: different URLs, labels and download names; similar JSX only
lenient Zod boundary normalisers of two wire shapes (the wire-shape rule wants one per payload)
assistant tool definitions: each tool reads its own route with its own arguments and answer shape (one tool = one readable unit, pinned by tool tests)
weight shares of saved axes (by id, activeAxes rule) vs of the unsaved editor draft (by key, archived flag): two shapes on purpose, four lines each
header totals of the screen and of the PDF over two different group types (CategoryGroup vs CategoryGroupPDF)
the planted-style look-alike: a menu moves on ArrowUp/ArrowDown, a tablist on ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (WAI-ARIA); same shape, different keys

one notice shape (icon, title, text, optional action) with page-specific copy and meaning: the no-forms and no-projects empty states, the Dashboard's no-match card, the needs-decision banner, the disabled-form notice and the load-failed notice
labelled inputs of the login forms (autocomplete, error wiring) and of the persona editor (onChange of a persona field)
section headers of two admin pages with different actions

three icon tab strips (agent detail, agents views, company) with different prefetch/guard handlers; CANDIDATE for one TabStrip, but Company's icons lack aria-hidden, so merging changes its accessibility tree (not a byte-identical consolidation)
row action buttons of the two explorer views (record vs object), each with its own icon set
empty/finished states of the prioritization list and the public ballot page (different bundles of the same SPA, different copy)
an empty-folder note and a jobs header
badges mapping different enums (decision verdict, run outcome) to tones
status icons for a trend and an onboarding step
form rows (label + select/number input) of the agent and workflow editors: different fields, bounds and i18n keys
a LabeledField + native select row of the workflow editor, the token form and the Product tab's lifecycle field: different options, state and i18n keys
two aria-pressed chip groups with different styles (buttons vs badges) and label sources; a shared component would need both as props
